narrative_markdown:
## Today's Forecast

Slightly cooler than yesterday; winds and cloud little changed. Showers reported at Kisumu International Airport as of 03:00, with thunder possible from the morning, peaking around midday. Rain began at Kisumu International Airport from 00:00, ahead of the 01:00 called. 28°C / 83°F high, 18°C / 65°F low. Sky mostly cloudy early as reported, partly cloudy at midday and overcast in the evening. Wind SW at midday; gusts to 38 km/h (20 kt). UV index 8.9 (very high). Air quality 45 (good) at Kisumu Airport, the highest of 3 stations. As of 06:01, reports through 03:00: rain from 00:00; no thunder; high so far 21°C / 70°F; low so far 20°C / 68°F; peak sustained 9 km/h; sky mostly cloudy.

## Extended Outlook

Warming through Monday, with rain and thunderstorms likely each day. Skies mostly cloudy Saturday and Sunday, then partly cloudy Monday. Monday's call: rain, 78%, with three of four models wet; highs around 30 °C. Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) calls it dry. At this lead ECMWF has the best record, right 80% of the time over 76 checks.

Further out, temperatures and winds much the same through Friday, with showers and thunderstorms likely Tuesday, dry Wednesday with thunderstorms likely, and showers and thunderstorms possible Thursday and Friday. Tuesday: two of four models wet, highs around 29 °C. Wednesday: three of four models wet, highs around 30 °C. Thursday: two of three models wet, highs much the same, thunder possible rather than likely.

Only GFS, ECMWF and ICON reach past Wednesday. ICON is the wetter solution from Tuesday to Wednesday; GFS, ECMWF and UKMO keep it drier. Friday's call: rain, 83%, with one of two models wet; highs around 28 °C. At this lead ECMWF has the best record, right 83% of the time over 72 checks.

## Severe Weather / Hazard Potential

Convective instability today: UKMO 2740 J/kg, ECMWF 1860 J/kg, ICON 1200 J/kg and GFS 980 J/kg. Thunder likely; any thunderstorm brings sudden gusts well above the 38 km/h (20 kt) forecast.

## Winam Gulf — Conditions for Boaters

Peak gust 29 km/h (15 kt). Any thunderstorm brings sudden gusts well above this figure; the water is unsafe while one is nearby.

## Detailed Discussion

### Synoptic Overview

Across roughly 2,600 km, pressure is lowest toward the north (1008 hPa) and highest toward the northeast (1014 hPa) — a 6 hPa spread, a moderate large-scale gradient. Pressure overhead is falling. Sampling is a nine-point ring at 12-degree spacing, so this locates a direction, not a centre or a front. Across the basin's 5 points, pressure today sits between 1015.4 and 1017.2 hPa, falling by 1.7 hPa over three days. Pressure here over the last 24 hours: -0.4 hPa.

### Forecaster Confidence Notes

On rain the record ranks ECMWF first at Day+3, right 80% of the last 30 checks and ECMWF first at Day+7, right 83% of the last 30 checks. On today's high ICON is the warmest model at 27.3 °C and ECMWF the coolest at 26.7 °C; the call's 28.3 °C sits at the warm end. Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) calls a high of 29.0 °C and rain, agreeing with the call on rain. At Day+0, no model is meaningfully better than the others here yet. At Day+7, ECMWF is the strongest rain caller here and GFS the weakest. At Day+0, Best Match slightly under-forecasts daytime highs here.

Figures issued 06:01. Written by code; a discussion follows when a model answers.
